reader.requirement: After a DELETE on an indexed file control goes per §1985:IX.1.3.5: invalid key with INVALID KEY runs imperative-1 and no USE procedure; invalid key without it runs the USE procedure; success runs NOT INVALID KEY; another exception (49) runs the USE procedure and neither phrase.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Year < 2002: the 1985-only mandatory INVALID KEY phrase or applicable USE procedure (§1985:IX.4.3.3 SR2), COBOL6826
ec.IoMaskFor(file): the EC-I-O arm and NotPhraseGate exist only where >>TURN enables an EC-I-O name (no such directive at 85), so 85 takes the plain __IoCheck arm

reader.edition-search: Grepped KeyedIoEmitter.cs/SequentialIoEmitter.cs for Edition|DialectLevel; the INVALID/NOT INVALID pair is IoStatusClass.InvalidKey/Successful with no edition test; the only edition switch on the path is the 1985 mandatory-phrase screen in the binder.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a DELETE in random/dynamic access with neither INVALID KEY nor an applicable USE is refused (COBOL6826, §1985:IX.4.3.3 SR2); 2002+ compiles it. Run-time transfer is the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_delete_invalid_key_transfer exercises the four arms on a RELATIVE file; probe p3 does them on an indexed file plus GO TO from the phrase and END-DELETE inside IF

probes.printed: A: A-INV | B: B-NOTINV | C: USE-RAN | E: E-JUMPED | F: F-AFTER-IN-IF G-INV | D: USE-RAN D-END
probes.expected: random-access indexed, no FILE STATUS, USE procedure: invalid key with INVALID KEY runs it and not USE (IX.1.3.5 GR2); success runs NOT INVALID KEY; invalid key without INVALID KEY runs USE, NOT INVALID KEY ignored (GR3); GO TO in INVALID KEY transfers; END-DELETE scoped in IF; '49' with both phrases runs USE only, neither phrase (GRL2.1)

probes.printed: COBOL2372 OPEN EXTEND 'IX' random access refused; COBOL1720 INVALID KEY on sequential-access DELETE refused; COBOL0900 the file COLLATING SEQUENCE clause requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: EXTEND only in sequential access (§1985:IX.4.4.3 SR1); no INVALID KEY in sequential access (§1985:IX.4.3.3 SR1); the SELECT COLLATING SEQUENCE clause is not 1985 syntax

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.3.4 GR8  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.5 GR2  (1.3.5 The Invalid Key Condition)  the text is in GR2
OK  §1985:IX.1.3.5 GRL2.1  (1.3.5 The Invalid Key Condition)  the text is in GRL2.1

reader.notes: The hook dispatches the USE procedure only for a status not taken by the phrase (invalidKeyHandled), and EmitPhrasePair runs INVALID KEY on 2x and NOT INVALID KEY on 0x only. Probe p3 prints A-INV, B-NOTINV, USE-RAN (C), E-JUMPED, F-AFTER-IN-IF, and for 49 USE-RAN with no phrase. Same output at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: r5usemode.cob (r5usemode-001): RANDOM indexed with USE ON INPUT, USE ON I-O and USE ON OUTPUT and DELETE ... NOT INVALID KEY only: open OUTPUT 49 runs USE-OUTPUT and not NOT INVALID KEY; open INPUT 49 runs USE-INPUT; I-O invalid key 23 runs USE-IO (no INVALID KEY phrase) and not NOT INVALID KEY; success runs D-NOTINV. The applicable USE is chosen by the open mode. Compiles at 85 with no INVALID KEY because USE ON I-O applies (SR2). OK §1985:IX.4.3.4 GR8.
